messages:
jules: Quick follow-up from the 01:10 UTC KV OOM. Short root-cause hypothesis: rising small-object retention + inter-slab fragmentation after shard-sync change. Posting concise actions; reply with owner + ETA.

jules: Action summary:
1) temporary soft-evict cap (canary) -> owner: ? -> ETA: 6h
2) 3-host heap captures + flamegraphs -> owner: ? -> ETA: 18h
3) add lightweight frag metric + dashboard -> owner: ? -> ETA: 8h
4) pointer-safety grep + quick audit of shard-sync commit -> owner: ? -> ETA: 24-48h
5) rollback/playbook doc (exact commands) -> owner: ? -> ETA: 6h

cara: I'll take (1) and (5). Plan: flip `kv.eviction.soft_pct = 85` via config canary (10% nodes us-west-2). Smoke test script and runbook snippet in PR. ETA ~4h. PR branch `cara/soft-evict` -> https://git.redwood/runtime/pull/1012

sven: I'll own (2) and pair with (4). Running `rd-heap-capture --svc=kv --secs=90 --out=s3://debug/kv/213456` on three recent-fail hosts (ids hc-213456-a/b/c). Will produce flamegraphs and upload. ETA 16h.

jules: For (3) propose metric `kv.frag_ratio = free_frag_bytes / used_bytes` sample 15s per shard; alert if > 0.28 for 10m. Also emit `kv.small_alloc_rate` (allocs <256B / min).

sara: I'll implement (3) in the agent and wire a provisional Grafana panel. ETA 6h. Will include per-shard heatmap and historical trend for last 7d.

cara: Canary rollout plan: 10% -> 50% -> 100% with 30m observation windows. Monitor: `kv.soft_evictions`, `srv.errors.oom`, `p99.api_lat`. Rollback triggers: p99 > baseline + 20% OR srv.errors.oom > 0 OR eviction_error_rate spike > 50%. Rollback command: `redwood deploy rollback --service kv-runtime --to previous`.

sven: Capture ids posted: hc-213456-a/b/c. Uploading now. Will run pointer grep for unsafe casts around commit `shard-sync: reduce copies` sha `e1c4f8`. If any unsafe sites found we block allocator changes.

ops-bot: [automated] Created ticket MEM-11045 "KV OOM - fragmentation follow-up" link: https://issue.redwood/MEM-11045

jules: Other notes: emit an event `EVT:kv.soft_evict shard=%s pct=%d` so we can correlate with spans. Add `kv.frag_ratio` to long-term perf retention if we see signal.

sara: Done: metric added to agent PR `sara/frag-metric` and provisional panels linked in ticket. I'll also add a noise filter: require two shards to show > threshold for 5m before alerting.

cara: Canary started at 10% (us-west-2). Seeing `kv.soft_evictions` ~2/min on a couple shards, no OOMs, p99 within baseline +5% after 20m. Monitoring closely.

sven: flamegraphs uploaded (fg-213456-1/2/3). Beginning pointer audit now.

jules: If canary is stable after 2 cycles, we'll consider compaction heuristic trial (compact_threshold=0.18) as a follow-up canary. Otherwise escalate an allocator RFC. Next sync in 24h; ping here for blockers. :thumbsup:
